summary: No operator website (its domain forwards to Facebook) and no posted rate anywhere; tourism listings confirm 84 serviced lots, year-round, phone booking, showers/laundry/wifi (written as reported). Google 4.2 from 36. Drop candidate on the private price indicator and long-stay test 2.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (private price indicator): no posted rate on any operator page, no booking engine, and RV Life's tier is $$$ (does not count). centennial-rv-park.ca answers 301 to https://www.facebook.com/centennialrvpark (Facebook is not a website). A web search for a rate found none. Presence passes on Google (4.2 from 36 reviews, phone +1 780-742-1307).

DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay test 2): Travel Alberta says 'Centennial is a great place for extended stays and has been home to many workers and newcomers to the area', FMWB says 'for short and long-term stays'; Esri imagery shows the loops packed with RVs. A long-stay park needs a nightly rate on its own website or a booking site that sells one night - it has neither.
PRICE GATE: unmeasurable (no rate); no gateway within 40 km.
GOOGLE: 'Centennial RV Park' 4.2 from 36 reviews, 395 Sakitawaw Trail, phone 780-742-1307 (matches stored).
WEBSITE: stored https://www.fmwb.ca/visit-explore/all-accommodations/centennial-rv-park answered 200 (a municipal tourism listing whose 'Website' link is the Facebook page).

PIN: stored 56.6805,-111.3555 is in the woods ~60 m west of the westernmost sites and ~110 m from the middle of the loops (about 56.6804,-111.3538); within tolerance. Not waterfront.
